conditional_normal_form: D_eta=i gamma^mu nabla_mu^total+Phi_response on the second-quantized FR-knot state bundle

inherited_quantization.FR_line: flat Z2 line over the odd-degree relative eta-knot configuration sector
inherited_quantization.rotor_Hamiltonian: H_rot=-(2 I_T)^(-1) Delta_moduli with FR equivariance
inherited_quantization.spin_selection: 2j=N mod 2; odd N admits lowest j=1/2
what_it_derives: collective rotor spectrum after an inertia tensor is supplied
what_it_does_not_derive: a local Spin(1,3) Clifford principal symbol
the relative speed relating temporal and spatial derivatives
a canonically normalized local Grassmann field

no_double_counting: Psi_eta may be used only as the low-energy second-quantized coordinate of eta-knot states; it is not an additional independent ultraviolet fermion integrated alongside the complete classical eta zero mode.
